data.name: MUSIC BAND SIMULATOR:TOGETHER
data.detailed_description:
Step onto the stage, crank up the amps, and let the music take over!

Are you ready to form your own band and rock the world? In this multiplayer music simulation, there are no predefined button prompts or restrictive tracks holding you back. Pick up your instruments and enjoy total freedom with realistic, responsive controls—play your favorite songs, compose original riffs, or jam freely with friends.

Key Features

  • Complete Musical Freedom: Take full control of lead guitar, rhythm guitar, bass guitar, drums, or grab the mic and provide live vocals. Every instrument is built to let your authentic creativity shine without artificial limits.

  • Online Multiplayer Band Sessions: Team up with friends or jam with musicians worldwide in real time. Rehearse in the studio, write new tracks together, or put on a live show.

  • Rise to Stardom: Build your band's reputation from the ground up! Gain popularity, earn devoted fans, and progress from small underground clubs to packed arena tours and massive stadium headliners.

  • Dynamic Audience & Venue Atmosphere: Feel the crowd's energy rise with your performance. As your fame grows, perform in bigger venues with reactive crowds, stunning stage lights, and roaring applause.

Tune your strings, set the beat, and claim the spotlight!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen R5 1600 processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GTX 1660 or higher.
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:

  • OS: Windows 10

  • Graphics: NVidia GTX 1080 or higher.
